Medical.description: Any document regarding healthcare (labs, scans, insurance EOBs). This does not include documents about healthcare insurance policies themselves.

Financial.description: Documents from bank accounts or investments (bank statements, retirement planning).

Property.description: Documents tied to the ownership of a physical address or vehicle (mortgage refinancing, property taxes, lease agreements).

Maintenance.description: Invoices for labor or parts involving maintenance, repair, or annual inspection of a home, vehicle, or appliance.

Insurance.description: Policy renewals, coverage summaries, or declarations pages (health, auto, home, life).

Warranty.description: Warranties, receipts for home appliances, or other documentation needed to have a product repaired or replaced for free.

Identity.description: Birth certificates, passports, or driver's licenses.

Utility.description: Recurring household bills (electricity, water, internet, trash).

Unknown.description: Use this category if you are unsure or if the document does not match any of the above.
